notes:
Snapshot: mid-stage enterprise legal discovery vendor building a multi-tenant RAG product for regulated customers. Key ask = private VPC deployment, full audit logging + 7yr retention / legal-hold integration. Scale: production target ~250M canonical docs (contracts, filings, transcripts) -> estimated ~350M embeddings; wants cost-per-query economics for 100-200 qps steady state. POC scope = ingest 10k sample docs, run embeddings + reranking pipeline, validate recall@10 and cost model.

Technical desiderata:
- Two-stage retrieval: ANN (HNSW/FAISS) at vector store -> candidate topK 200 -> cross-encoder rerank (small distil-cross) for final top10.
- Latency SLOs: median retrieval <120ms, end-to-end rerank <=350ms for single-query (p95 <700ms acceptable under load).
- Throughput target: 150 qps baseline; burst to 400 qps during e-discovery runs.
- Cost target: ~$0.003-0.006 per end-user query (includes embeddings + reranker compute).
- Indexing cadence: nightly delta + weekly full reindex; urgent legal-holds require on-demand pinning.

Security / compliance notes:
- Cannot allow document egress outside customer VPC (must use Redwood Private with control-plane separation).
- Require AES-256 at rest + customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/HSM), audit logs for every retrieval & token access, and retention controls per jurisdiction (US + EU).
- SSO via Okta SAML; need attribute mapping for RBAC and legal-hold groups.
- Data residency: primary in us-east-1, EU copies in eu-west-1 for EU clients.

Sales / conversation highlights:
- 2026-02-12 intro call (AE Jordan) — CTO: "can't expose docs outside VPC — must run private. We'll pay premium for guaranteed isolation."
- 2026-02-22 technical deep-dive (SE Maya) — discussed ANN tuning and cross-encoder latency tradeoffs; asked for quantized embedding model options to reduce storage/cost.
- 2026-03-04 security sync (infra + legal) — asked for SOC2 evidence, encryption proofs, and SIEM export examples. Provided RDW tickets for gaps.

POC acceptance criteria (customer-specified):
- Ingest sample 10k doc set, run end-to-end queries against legal eval set (precision@5 >= 0.78, recall@10 >= 0.85).
- End-to-end median latency <350ms for reranked results at 5 concurrent qps baseline in VPC POC.
- Demonstrate audit log export to their Splunk instance + KMS integration.

Commercials & governance:
- Prefers annual committed Dedicated or Private subscription; willing to start with 3-month paid POC (budget committee approval pending).
- Wants clear uplift numbers for dedicated GPUs vs shared hosted for reranker step.

AE notes / next moves: schedule 2-week VPC POC provisioning (private control plane), deliver Sizing doc & cost-per-query modeling by 2026-03-10, security deep-dive follow-up 2026-03-12.

architecture_notes: Recommended approach: Redwood Private in customer VPC with dedicated GPU pool for cross-encoder rerank. Use optimized quantized embedding model (8-bit) for storage savings; enable prefix/KV caching for repeated queries. Routing policy: primary region us-east-1, fallback to dedicated cold region for batch reindex. Provide SIEM-compatible audit log sink (CloudWatch -> Splunk). Provide canary deploy path for model rollouts and automatic fallback to cheaper approximate reranker when load spikes.
